## Land Pricing and Available Plots

Six residential plots remain from sixteen total at Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan, priced from 2,500,000 to 7,000,000 THB with Chanote title deeds.

Plots currently available (2026):
- Plot 1: 1,396 m² — 3,500,000 THB
- Plot 2a: 1,070 m² — 2,500,000 THB (entry plot)
- Plot 3: 2,056 m² — 5,000,000 THB
- Plot 6: 2,824 m² — 7,000,000 THB
- Plot 9: 2,324 m² — 6,500,000 THB
- Plot 16: 2,164 m² — 5,400,000 THB

All plots include access to 12+ rai of common green space, private lake, walkways, chapel island, and shared infrastructure. Residential use only.

## Foreign Buyers — 30-Year Lease

Foreign nationals cannot own land freehold in Thailand. At NHVK, Thai buyers purchase with Chanote freehold. Foreign buyers may use a registered 30-year renewable lease — a standard long-term tenure for residential land. Consult a Thai property lawyer for personal circumstances. Contact: 081 860 4501 (EN/FR), kaengkrachan.village@proton.me.

## Solar, Water and Utilities

- 3-phase PEA electricity, individual meter per plot
- Solar panels in progress toward energy autonomy
- Private deep well, storage tank, pump
- Three water lines per plot with individual meters
- Public water connection available
- All electrical and water cables buried underground

## Location

Kaengkrachan, Phetchaburi Province, Thailand. ~2.5 hours from Bangkok. 40 km to Hua Hin and Cha-am. 4 km to Kaengkrachan National Park entrance. 1 km to Khao Kling mountain. Hospital 2 km.
